WITH m AS (SELECT TO_CHAR(submitted_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS mon, SUM(total_amount) AS amt FROM purchase_orders WHERE submitted_at >= '2026-08-01' AND submitted_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT '2026-08' AS "月份", (SELECT amt FROM m WHERE mon = '2026-08') AS "采购金额", (SELECT amt FROM m WHERE mon = '2026-09') - (SELECT amt FROM m WHERE mon = '2026-08') AS "变化金额", ROUND(CAST((((SELECT amt FROM m WHERE mon = '2026-09') - (SELECT amt FROM m WHERE mon = '2026-08')) / (SELECT amt FROM m WHERE mon = '2026-08') * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "变化百分比" LIMIT 100
